name: TobiDash Tools
description: Touch-friendly experimental speed, noclip, and icon-unlock toggles for Geometry Dash.

speedhack.name: Speed hack
speedhack.description: Apply the selected game-time multiplier while playing. This affects the global scheduler, including animations.

speed-multiplier.name: Speed multiplier
speed-multiplier.description: Used only while Speed hack is enabled. 1.0x is normal speed.

noclip.name: Noclip
noclip.description: Skip player-object collisions while playing. This also bypasses pads, orbs and portals, so turn it off for normal gameplay.

unlock-icons.name: Unlock icons (visual)
unlock-icons.description: Makes icon unlock checks return true locally. It does not grant or sync online progress.
